run.description: REC-2: the path of run.json from the run directory (the Run is not copied here).

pages.description: REC-2: the paths of the page.json of the pages from the run directory, in the page order (the pages are not copied here).

findings.description: T44f (Task 44 design P3-1 B): the Findings not in the findings of any page (the Findings of the Run rules, such as the cross-page rules; some have a page ID). The Findings of a page are in the findings of its page.json only. All the Findings of the Run are the page Findings (in the page order) followed by these.
